points.description: States that all dimensions after the first must be specified (equivalently, the number of dimensions that must be specified is the total number of dimensions minus one).
States that the first dimension does not need to be specified / may be omitted (the first dimension is the exception).

rubric.notes: Full marks require saying that all dimensions except the first must be specified, or equivalently n−1 dimensions / every dimension after the first. Award P1 for stating that all remaining dimensions must be specified, and P2 for stating that the first dimension may be omitted. No marks for saying only the first dimension must be specified or for an unrelated answer.
